name: Meridian AI
description: Access Meridian data directly from Claude, without spreadsheet exports or copy/pasting context. Query deal history, IC decisions, relationships, documents, and reports. Your firm’s data security and granular privacy settings remain intact.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Meridian AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Meridian AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.meridian-ai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Meridian AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meridian AI lists 13 MCP tools, including get_report_data, list_filter_attributes, search_companies, search_deals, search_document_content, search_documents, search_emails, search_interactions, search_meetings, search_notes, search_people, and search_reports.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Meridian AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Meridian AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Meridian AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meridian AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Meridian AI is developed by Meridian AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
